title: 对比与比较

sentenceFrames.usage: 直接对比两个事物，突出差异。比 "A is... but B is..." 更紧凑。
sentenceFrames.example: Compared to 10 years ago, life today is way more convenient but also way more distracting.
substitutions: Compared to **10 years ago**, life today is _____.
Compared to **reading English**, speaking English is _____.
Compared to **my parents' generation**, my generation is _____.
Compared to **small cities**, big cities are _____.
你自己的对比：Compared to _____, _____ is _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：The main difference is [key point]. [A] is [adj], whereas [B] is [adj].
sentenceFrames.usage: 先点出核心差异，再并列对比。适合回答"What's the difference?"。
sentenceFrames.example: The main difference is the pace of life. City life is fast-paced and stimulating, whereas country life is slow and peaceful.
substitutions: 远程工作 vs 办公室工作** → The main difference is _____. Working from home is _____, whereas working in an office is _____.
线上学习 vs 线下学习** → The main difference is _____. Online learning is _____, whereas in-person learning is _____.
年轻时的学习 vs 成年后的学习** → The main difference is _____. Learning as a kid is _____, whereas learning as an adult is _____.
你自己的对比：The main difference between _____ and _____ is _____.

sentenceFrames.usage: 先承认相似之处，再点出区别。比只说"they're different"更有洞察力。
sentenceFrames.example: Reading and speaking are similar in that both require vocabulary and grammar, but speaking requires real-time retrieval — there's no time to look up a word mid-sentence.
substitutions: Chinese and English** → They're similar in that _____, but _____.
Working and studying** → They're similar in that _____, but _____.
Movies and books** → They're similar in that _____, but _____.
你自己找一组对比：They're similar in that _____, but _____.

collocations.english: there's not much in it / pretty much the same
each has its pros and cons
A is far superior to B / B doesn't even come close
they're becoming more and more alike

shadowingTopic: Comparing and contrasting in English conversation 或 English compare and contrast essay speaking
impromptuTopic: Compare your life now to your life 5 years ago. What's changed and what's stayed the same?
